name: Spain
description: Follow Spain, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Photos: See the best photos from the solar eclipse
changes.summary: Millions of people in Europe stepped outside this evening to watch a spectacular sunset with a solar eclipse. The path of totality passed through portions of Greenland, Iceland and Spain, (Image credit: Christian Hartmann).

changes.title: Total solar eclipse mesmerizes crowds throughout Europe
changes.summary: On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse awed onlookers throughout Europe, including in Spain and the United Kingdom. Video Producer: Martina Di Licosa.

changes.title: Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century
changes.summary: As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered. It was the Spain's first total solar eclipse in more than a century. (Image credit: Antonio Calanni).

changes.title: Too smart to eat? Why octopus farms are such a slippery problem
changes.summary: As a controversial Spanish plan for sustainable meat on an industrial scale is dropped, it has revived the ethical debate over farming these intelligent wild animals In 2022 Nueva Pescanova, Spain’s largest fisheries business, announced it was investing €65m (£56m) in the world’s first industrial octopus farm and proce.

changes.title: Total solar eclipse darkens skies across Northern Hemisphere
changes.summary: The only total solar eclipse of 2026 crossed the Northern Hemisphere today, with a path of totality across parts of Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain. See photos and video from the best viewing locations.

changes.title: Spain witnesses first total solar eclipse in 27 years
changes.summary: NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports on the ground in Spain as crowds revel and cheer at the total solar eclipse taking place during the sunset hour.

changes.title: PHOTOS: Millions gather to watch Europe's first total solar eclipse in decades
changes.summary: Millions of people crowded cloudless cities and towns in Spain on Wednesday in search of the best views of a total solar eclipse, when the alignment of the sun, moon and Earth will briefly plunge parts of the planet into darkness.

changes.title: Once-in-a-lifetime total solar eclipse sweeps across Europe
changes.summary: The moon passed directly in front of the sun Wednesday, briefly turning day into twilight as crowds from Iceland to Spain looked up in awe at the rare celestial spectacle. NBC News’ Gadi Schwartz reports.

changes.title: A look at Spain's plan to give undocumented migrants legal status
changes.summary: Spain is at the center of the global immigration debate. Left-wing Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has enacted a plan aimed at giving legal status to undocumented immigrants. changes.title: A Space Expert Hoped to Use the Eclipse as Science Class. The D.J.s Had Other Plans.
changes.summary: Mar Carretero-Castrillo, an astrophysicist, returned to her remote village in Spain to be in the path of totality. Hundreds of partygoers came too.
